basic_details.job_title: NIT Silchar Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Project Associate-I post is open in the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology Silchar. The post serves the project "ML-Driven ISAC for Hybrid Satellite–Terrestrial 6G Connectivity", sponsored by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Govt. of India. The post runs for two years and pays INR 37,000 per month to GATE/NET-qualified candidates, or 30,000 per month otherwise, plus HRA @10% if Institute accommodation is not provided. qualification.details: Minimum B. Tech/B.E. in ECE/CSE/EE/E&I from the recognized university.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form given in the notice (Annexure 01(A)-2, "Format of Application" for the post of Project Associate-I).
Prepare your C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents.
Email the soft copy of the filled form, your C.V. and your documents to the PI at [email protected].
Use this subject line: "Application for the post of JRF under the project-(ML-Driven ISAC for Hybrid Satellite–Terrestrial 6G Connectivity), ANRF/ECRG/2025/003836/ENS".
Make sure the application reaches the PI by 13 November 2026.
For any queries, contact the PI at [email protected].
Filled application form (Annexure 01(A)-2), with a recent passport-size coloured photograph pasted on it
Soft copy of all supporting documents
Category certificate, if you belong to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD
No objection certificate from your employer, if you are employed (to be submitted at the time of interview)

The application form asks for the advertisement number and date, the project title, the funding agency, the department, and your personal details. These include your name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth (DD-MM-YYYY), gender, marital status, age as on the last date of application, postal and permanent address, email, phone number, nationality and category. The form also asks for:
your educational qualifications from Class X onwards (board/university, division, percentage of marks/CPI, year of passing, subjects)
NET/GATE details (subject, qualifying date or score, and validity)
your employment details (organisation, post, period, scale of pay and present pay, nature of duty)
a signed declaration with the date and place
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining the post. All terms and conditions for this recruitment will follow the guidelines of the sponsoring agency and NIT Silchar. No candidate may be recruited if no suitable candidates are found. Selected candidates must sign an agreement at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: NIT Silchar Project Associate-I at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Silchar (Office of the Dean (Research & Consultancy))
ML-Driven ISAC for Hybrid Satellite–Terrestrial 6G Connectivity
Two (02) years (extension based on performance review every 12 months)
INR. 37,000/- month (GATE/NET qualified) else 30,000/- per month, plus HRA @10% if Institute Accommodation is not provided

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens only. Minimum B. Tech/B.E. in ECE/CSE/EE/E&I from the recognized university. A solid understanding of digital communication, probability theory, optimization, and wireless communications is crucial. Experience with programming languages; MATLAB or Python. The age limit is 35 years, as on the closing date of application, 13 November 2026. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates will get relaxation in qualification and age as per Govt. of India Rules. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA @10% is paid on top of this pay if Institute Accommodation is not provided. The post is temporary and lasts two years. It can be extended based on a performance review every 12 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given in the notice (Annexure 01(A)-2, "Format of Application" for the post of Project Associate-I). Prepare your C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents. Email the soft copy of the filled form, your C.V. and your documents to the PI at [email protected] . Use this subject line: "Application for the post of JRF under the project-(ML-Driven ISAC for Hybrid Satellite–Terrestrial 6G Connectivity), ANRF/ECRG/2025/003836/ENS". Make sure the application reaches the PI by 13 November 2026. For any queries, contact the PI at [email protected] . Filled application form (Annexure 01(A)-2), with a recent passport-size coloured photograph pasted on it C.V. Soft copy of all supporting documents Category certificate, if you belong to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD No objection certificate from your employer, if you are employed (to be submitted at the time of interview) your educational qualifications from Class X onwards (board/university, division, percentage of marks/CPI, year of passing, subjects) NET/GATE details (subject, qualifying date or score, and validity) your employment details (organisation, post, period, scale of pay and present pay, nature of duty) any other relevant information a signed declaration with the date and place

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through screening followed by an interview. The Institute may limit the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview based on the screening. The interview date and mode (online/offline) and other details will be notified through email. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Silchar Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Project Associate-I post. It is in the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The filled application form (soft copy) must reach the PI by email by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Minimum B. Tech/B.E. in ECE/CSE/EE/E&I from the recognized university. Knowledge of digital communication, probability theory, optimization and wireless communications, and experience with MATLAB or Python, are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, as on 13 November 2026. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates get relaxation in age and qualification as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: GATE/NET-qualified candidates get INR 37,000 per month, and others get 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form (Annexure 01(A)-2), your C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents to [email protected] by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: The subject line is "Application for the post of JRF under the project-(ML-Driven ISAC for Hybrid Satellite–Terrestrial 6G Connectivity), ANRF/ECRG/2025/003836/ENS".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted through screening and then interviewed. The interview date and mode (online/offline) will be notified through email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary post for two years. It can be extended based on a performance review every 12 months, and selected candidates must sign an agreement at the time of joining.
